name: Order of Hermes
description: The dominant organization of Hermetic magi in Mythic Europe, which historically offered hedge wizards the choice to 'Join or Die' and relies on its magi's ability to resist hedge magic.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting in which hedge wizard traditions coexist with, and live in the shadow of, the Order of Hermes.

name: Hedge Wizard
description: Any practitioner of a hedge tradition; the Order usually considers only Gifted ones to be 'proper' wizards.

name: Hedge Magic
description: Non-Hermetic magical traditions drawing power from the Magic realm, normally bound by the Limits of Magic and considerably less powerful than Hermetic magic.

name: Mathematici
description: Scholarly learned magicians who cluster in universities, one of the hedge traditions of the book.

name: Folk Witches
description: Hedge tradition of witches who ply their trade in villages, organized into small covens; they have not solved the social problems of The Gift.

name: Elementalists
description: Hedge tradition that controls the four elements through Elementalist Techniques and Forms; in 1220 they tend to look like academics.

name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge wizards who deal out curses and blessings in the interests of justice.

name: Nightwalkers
description: Hedge tradition whose members leave their bodies to fight for the prosperity of their homes; their abilities resemble certamen.

name: Vitkir
description: Rune wizards of the frozen north of Scandinavia who clash with trolls.

name: Trollsynir
description: An alternate tradition related to Gruagach magic.

name: Kolduni
description: An alternate tradition related to Gruagach magic.

name: Mythic Alchemists
description: An alternate tradition related to the learned magicians.

name: Cunning-folk
description: An alternate tradition related to the learned magicians.

name: Benandanti
description: A local tradition of nightwalkers.

name: The Hounds of God
description: A local tradition of nightwalkers.

name: Kresniki and Kudlaki
description: Local nightwalker traditions.

name: Mazzeru
description: A local tradition of nightwalkers.

name: Taltós
description: A local tradition of nightwalkers.

name: Apostles of Apollonius
description: An elementalist society.

name: Ikhwan as-Safa'
description: An elementalist society, the Brethren of Purity, whose Epistles are referenced.

name: Tulab Ibn Sina
description: An elementalist society associated with the writings of Ibn Sina.

name: Ibn Sina
description: Scholar whose writings are associated with an elementalist society.

name: Order of Odin
description: An organization discussed in the vitkir chapter.

name: Lineage of Pralix
description: Magi who seek to invite hedge wizards into House Ex Miscellanea.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: The Hermetic House through which hedge wizards join the Order of Hermes.

name: Redcaps
description: UnGifted members of the Order who remain honorary magi through tradition and decline to exercise their votes at Tribunal.

name: Hoplites
description: Zealous magi who sometimes scour the land searching for hedge wizards to best in combat.

name: Bonisagus
description: Author of Hermetic theory and inventor of the Parma Magica, the only Hermetic Breakthrough in 450 years.

name: Bonisagus Seekers
description: Hermetic magi who eagerly hunt rumors of hedge traditions to gain insights into magic theory.

name: House Bonisagus
description: Hermetic House whose magi can gain Acclaim for completing Breakthroughs.

name: House Tremere
description: Hermetic House mentioned as a trademark.

name: Doissetep
description: Hermetic covenant named as a trademark.

name: Grimgroth
description: Hermetic figure named as a trademark.

name: Bjornaer Heartbeast
description: Ability of House Bjornaer that grants a defense like Strength of Form, retained from the House's pre-Hermetic tradition.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House with the Heartbeast Ability from its pre-Hermetic tradition.

name: The Gift
description: Innate capacity for magic; required to join the Order and to Open a hedge tradition, and it imposes a social penalty.

name: Gentle Gift
description: Variant of The Gift without the usual social penalty; also listed as an elementalist Virtue.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Variant of The Gift, listed as a Major elementalist Flaw.

name: Opening The Gift
description: Season-long ritual by which a Gifted hedge master Opens an apprentice's Gift to a tradition, governed by an Opening Total vs Opening Ease Factor.

name: Opening of the Arts
description: The Hermetic equivalent of Opening The Gift; harder if the apprentice's Gift was already Opened by a hedge tradition.

name: Flawed Opening of The Gift
description: If the master lacks a score of 2 in each tradition power, the apprentice gains Flaws such as Deficient Art.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: Oath by which a hedge wizard officially joins the Order, gaining legal rights such as voting at Tribunal.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Order's law, which prohibits scrying on members.

name: Tribunal
description: Hermetic assembly where members vote and which may censure magi.

name: Parma Magica
description: Hermetic Arcane Ability granting Magic Resistance and shielding magi from the social effects of The Gift; the Order fears hedge wizards learning it.

name: Certamen
description: Magical duel unique to the Order of Hermes; hedge wizards without Opened Hermetic Arts cannot participate.

name: Hermetic Magus
description: Free Social Status Virtue gained by a hedge wizard upon swearing the Oath of Hermes.

name: Hedge Wizard (Flaw)
description: Minor Hermetic Flaw representing discrimination against hedge wizard converts.

name: Dark Secret
description: Major Story Flaw for a convert who secretly maintains ties to his hedge colleagues.

name: Mystery Cults
description: Hermetic cults whose Initiation rules hedge initiations resemble.

name: The Numbness of The Gift
description: InVi 20 spell (Personal, Conc, Touch) making the caster's hand feel numb on touching a Gifted character.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Technique used with Vim to detect The Gift.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Form used to detect or disguise The Gift.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Technique of control, typically resisted by the Immovable Object defense.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Technique of transformation, resisted by the Strength of Form defense.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Form; the folk witch Healing Ability gives Magical Fortitude against Corpus effects.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Form of mind, which might be used to control a hedge wizard teacher.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Form of water; its vis is usable with Elementalist Water.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form of air; its vis is usable with Elementalist Air.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Form of fire; its vis is usable with Elementalist Fire.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Form of earth; its vis is usable with Elementalist Earth.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance to magic from Form scores and Parma; no hedge tradition has general magic resistance.

name: Limits of Magic
description: Hermetic theories describing the boundaries of magic; hedge magic is normally bound by them, though oddities suggest errors in Bonisagus' theory.

name: Limit of Magic Resistance
description: Apparent limit that no hedge tradition has general magic resistance; traditions breaking it would be eliminated by the Order.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: Protective ritual over covenants; hedge effects must penetrate it and casting within it is penalized.

name: Penetration
description: Arcane Ability; hedge effects must penetrate an Aegis.

name: Might
description: Might Score of magical beings; hedge wizards without one enter an Aegis freely.

name: Magic Realm
description: The realm from which the hedge traditions of this book draw power.

name: Divine
description: Realm from which some other hedge traditions draw power.

name: Infernal
description: Realm from which some hedge traditions draw power; source of (Spirit) Summoning.

name: Faerie
description: Realm from which some hedge traditions draw power.

name: Hedge Arts
description: Arts of a hedge tradition combined like Hermetic Techniques and Forms, not compatible with Hermetic Arts.

name: Difficult Arts
description: Hedge Arts that advance as Abilities, preventing easy high Penetration.

name: Accelerated Abilities
description: Abilities that advance like Arts, counterpart to Difficult Arts.

name: Favored Abilities
description: Supernatural Abilities favored by a tradition that Gifted members can learn without subtracting their Supernatural total.

name: Magical Defenses
description: Limited hedge defenses that grant a bonus or penalty in an area of specialty, equal to Art/5 or Ability score.

name: Accelerated Expiry
description: Magical defense causing spells on the hedge wizard to expire early.

name: Akacritous Fortune
description: Magical defense adding the Magical Defense Bonus to Defense Total against aimed spells.

name: Confounding Magics
description: Magical defense raising the Ease Factor of casters' Concentration rolls.

name: Immovable Object
description: Magical defense letting the hedge wizard roll to resist controlling effects.

name: Magical Fortitude
description: Magical defense adding bonus to Soak against damaging effects.

name: Strength of Form
description: Magical defense allowing a roll to return to natural form against transformation.

name: Warping
description: Accumulated supernatural effects; hedge wizards don't gain it from strong magic auras and each tradition responds uniquely.

name: Wizard's Twilight
description: The Order of Hermes' unique response to Warping.

name: Twilight Scars
description: Physical marks magi gain from Twilight, compared to elementalist warping traits.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used by some hedge traditions; detectable via Magic Sensitivity or lore.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Supernatural Ability to detect vis and magic.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Ability granted by a Major Virtue, used in the Opening example.

name: Flight
description: Folk witch Supernatural Ability requiring the Flight Virtue.

name: Cursing
description: Folk witch Ability granting an Accelerated Expiry defense against Arcane Connection effects.

name: Healing
description: Folk witch Ability granting Magical Fortitude against Corpus.

name: Magic Lore
description: Arcane Ability of magical knowledge accessible via hedge Social Status.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Lore Ability pagan hedge wizards may begin with.

name: Finesse
description: Arcane Ability accessible to hedge wizards.

name: Magic Theory
description: Hermetic Arcane Ability of theory, used for Insight rolls.

name: (Hedge Magic) Theory
description: Arcane Ability covering the technical details of a hedge tradition's magic.

name: (Organization) Lore
description: General Ability of knowledge about a hedge tradition's legends, history and goals.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Knowledge a spying hedge wizard might gain.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Ability used in learned magicians' Opening Total.

name: Medicine
description: Academic Ability linked to Elemental Medicine and Elemental Affinity.

name: Philosophiae
description: Academic Ability linked to Elemental Philosophiae.

name: (Realm) Lore
description: Lore linked to Elemental Theurgy and Elemental Affinity.

name: Guile
description: Ability used by a saboteur hedge wizard to deceive a magus.

name: Social Contacts
description: Minor Virtue representing hedge wizard allies of a magus.

name: Personal Vis Source
description: Minor Virtue representing vis trade; also an elementalist Virtue.

name: Hedge Tradition (Covenant Boon)
description: Major Covenant Boon/Hook representing a covenant allied with (or enemy of) a hedge tradition.

name: Local Ally
description: Minor Covenant Boon for a lone hedge wizard near a covenant.

name: Hedge Wizard (Social Status)
description: Free Social Status for tradition members, granting access to tradition powers.

name: Greater Magical Defenses
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue doubling Magical Defense Bonuses.

name: Known Hedge Wizard
description: Major Story Flaw: the character is known to and watched by the Order.

name: Pagan
description: Major Story Flaw for unbaptized hedge wizards who avoid churchmen and the Dominion.

name: No Magical Defenses
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw removing Magical Defense Bonuses.

name: Mythic Companion
description: A powerful unGifted character with up to 21 points of Virtues.

name: Gifted Companion
description: Hedge wizard created as a companion with The Gift, the most powerful hedge wizard type.

name: Grog
description: Minor unGifted hedge wizard with up to three Minor Virtues.

name: Magus
description: A Hermetic wizard of the Order.

name: Initiation
description: Rites where a Mystagogue guides an Initiate through a Script to gain a Virtue.

name: Mystagogue
description: Member who directs an Initiation.

name: Ordeal
description: Gaining a Flaw during Initiation; required for unGifted initiations.

name: Breakthrough
description: Integration of hedge magic into Hermetic theory via breakthrough points: Minor, Major or Hermetic.

name: Insight
description: Understanding gained from texts, relics or teachers, allowing a partially Hermetic effect.

name: Original Research
description: Rules from True Lineages for extending Hermetic magic by inspiration.

name: Ancient Magic
description: Extinct traditions, discussed in a separate book, whose integration rules parallel hedge ones.

name: Inventive Genius
description: Adds 3 to Insight rolls.

name: Flexible Formulaic Magic
description: Allows varying spells at casting time.

name: Extraordinary Results
description: Chart rolled on during experimentation.

name: Acclaim
description: Recognition a Bonisagus earns for Breakthroughs.

name: Ars Goetia
description: Ancient system of magic over spirits, branded sorcery; precursor to elementalist arts.

name: Elementalist Arts
description: Four Techniques and four Forms of elementalist magic, used in combination.

name: Summoning
description: Elementalist Technique that summons a target associated with an element.

name: Controlling
description: Elementalist Technique controlling elemental beings.

name: Divining
description: Elementalist Technique to locate, understand and predict elements.

name: Refining
description: Elementalist Technique purifying a target via the elements.

name: Elementalist Air
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of air, affecting sanguine humors, weather, birds and air elementals.

name: Elementalist Earth
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of earth, affecting melancholic humors, minerals and earth elementals.

name: Elementalist Fire
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of fire, affecting heat, flame and fire elementals.

name: Elementalist Water
description: Difficult Elementalist Form of water, affecting phlegmatic humors, liquids and water elementals.

name: Elementalist Air (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Air 0 and a Sanguine trait.

name: Elementalist Earth (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Earth 0 and a Melancholic trait.

name: Elementalist Fire (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Fire 0 and a Choleric trait.

name: Elementalist Water (Virtue)
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Elementalist Water 0 and a Phlegmatic trait.

name: (Type) Summoning
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Summoning 0 for a type.

name: (Type) Controlling
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Controlling 0.

name: (Type) Divining
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Divining 0.

name: (Type) Refining
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Refining 0.

name: Elemental Affinity
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving Elementalist Form xp when studying a chosen Ability.

name: Elemental Magic
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving bonus xp to other Forms and use of highest Form; Hermetic version affects Aquam, Auram, Ignem, Terram.

name: Elemental Medicine
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving Form xp when studying Medicine.

name: Elemental Philosophiae
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving Form xp when studying Philosophiae.

name: Elemental Theurgy
description: Major Supernatural Virtue giving Form xp when studying (Realm) Lore.

name: Affinity with (Art)
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Cyclic Magic
description: Available positive (Virtue) and negative (Flaw) for elementalists.

name: Fast Caster
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Free Study
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Inoffensive to Animals
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Puissant (Art)
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Special Circumstances
description: Minor Virtue available to elementalists.

name: Magical Focus
description: Virtue affecting Arts, including Difficult Arts.

name: Restriction
description: Major Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Study Requirement
description: Major Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Weak Elemental Resistance
description: Major Flaw: elemental traits don't add to Soak; Hermetic version weakens Magic Resistance vs elements.

name: Vulnerable to (Form)
description: Minor Flaw subtracting the opposing elemental trait from Soak.

name: Deleterious Circumstances
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Offensive to Animals
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Slow Caster
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Susceptibility to Divine Power
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Susceptibility to Faerie Power
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Susceptibility to Infernal Power
description: Minor Flaw available to elementalists.

name: Deficient Art
description: Typical Flaw from a flawed Opening.

name: Elemental Warping
description: Elementalist warping as elemental Personality Traits that add to Soak and can cause madness.

name: Choleric
description: Elemental trait of Elementalist Fire promoting anger; opposes Phlegmatic.

name: Melancholic
description: Elemental trait of Elementalist Earth for sorrow; opposes Sanguine.

name: Phlegmatic
description: Elemental trait of Elementalist Water for jealousy and worry; opposes Choleric.

name: Sanguine
description: Elemental trait of Elementalist Air for delight and love; opposes Melancholic.

name: Four Humors
description: Bodily humors studied by elemental physicians.

name: Elemental Physician
description: Elementalist with a Medicinal Technique.

name: Elemental Philosopher
description: Elementalist with a Philosophical Technique.

name: Elemental Theurgist
description: Elementalist with a Theurgical Technique.

name: Elementals
description: Animate creatures of the elements that elemental theurgists affect.

name: Air Elemental
description: Elemental with high mental and low physical Characteristics.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Elemental with high physical and low mental Characteristics.

name: Fire Elemental
description: Elemental high in Presence, Communication, Dexterity, Quickness.

name: Water Elemental
description: Elemental high in Cunning, Perception, Strength, Stamina.

name: Iberia
description: Region where elementalist arts spread during the eighth-century Arab conquests.

name: Scandinavia
description: Frozen wastes where rune wizards clash with trolls.

name: Trolls
description: Creatures vitkir clash with in Scandinavia.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura bonus added to Lab Totals and vis study.

name: Stefano
description: A learned magician who tries to Open Sarah's Gift.

name: Sarah
description: A young Gifted girl with Entrancement and Magic Sensitivity in the example.

name: Marco the Student
description: A learned magician example character.

name: Succurro
description: Learned magician Art used in the Opening Total.

name: Magicam
description: Learned magician Art used in the Opening Total.

description: Learned magician Art.

description: Learned magician Art.

name: Tueor
description: Learned magician Art.

name: Vulnero
description: Learned magician Art.

name: Coven
description: Group of folk witches, created with rules based on covenant creation.

name: Sabbat
description: Folk witch gatherings.

name: Elisavet
description: Elementalist character known as Psychorrhax.

description: A folk witch character sidebar in the Folk Witches chapter.

description: A folk witch character sidebar in the Folk Witches chapter.

description: A folk witch character sidebar in the Folk Witches chapter.

description: A folk witch character sidebar in the Folk Witches chapter.

description: A gruagach character.

name: Master Conall the Gruagach
description: A gruagach master character.

description: Subject of a gruagachan story seed.

name: Rothiger
description: A Hound of God companion, also shown in wolf form.

name: Arno
description: A Benandante companion.

name: Eirik Svennson
description: A warrior vitki.

name: Odin
description: God whose sacrifice underlies the runes.

name: Aristeas
description: Subject of a nightwalker story seed.

name: Ekstasis
description: Nightwalker spirit-straying power.

name: Fertility Battles
description: Nightwalker spirit battles for prosperity.

description: Rune set used by vitkir.

description: Rune set.

description: Rune set.

description: New Virtue from folk witch integration.
